column1: # Maps clade/subgenogroup names onto the ground-truth nomenclature used for scoring,
# which is the `clade_membership` column of testing/nextstrain_vp1_metadata.tsv.
# tool      "rivm" or "nextclade" - the tool whose output is being renamed
# from      the name as that tool reports it
# to        the equivalent name in clade_membership
# Only genuine renames belong here. Coarser-vs-finer answers do NOT: the scorer
# understands the clade hierarchy (C for a C1 fragment is scored `ancestral`,
# B2 for a B fragment `descendant`), so RIVM's coarse C1/C2 labels need no mapping.
# clade_membership over the 9,127 sequences carrying both labels. Every RIVM label
# All remaining RIVM labels (B1, B3, B4, B5, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, D, E, F, G) matched
# clade_membership exactly and need no mapping.
